metadata.description: Japan's first long-distance nature trail, from 明治の森高尾 (Tokyo) to 明治の森箕面 (Osaka). The main line from the Ministry of the Environment's GPS data, one item per track; its 115 branch and detour tracks (本線以外, about 360 km) are left out.
